caption: Hi #pretenders! #👽
author: Priscilla 寶珊
transcript: You're going to love it yourself so hard when in the end you realize that this was a pretend game. You're playing pretend to yourself like the entire goal was to trick yourself. This is a game where you pretend you don't know who you are. You pretend that you didn't know that this is just a body costume. You pretend that you took everything for real and you pretend to maybe go on a truth seeking journey to find out what's going on. And you also pretend that you thought there were other people out there besides you who actually exist. And you pretend to interact with them and to fight them and to learn from them too. And you pretend that there was a face of not knowing. Oh, what's going on? What's everybody talking about? What's the truth? I don't understand. And then you pretend that after this process of learning and practicing, you pray, you meditate, you soul search, and finally you pretend that you have arrived. You pretend to finally know the truth. And then you realize this was a big fat cosmic joke that I played on myself. I was here all along. I was here the whole time. I was saved the whole time. I was all knowing. I was complete the whole time. I am the true essence. I am myself, but I kind of just devised this game to be played with that wasn't necessary. I could have just stayed home. I could have just chilled and at this point, you're like, what can I do? There's nothing I can do but laugh.
title: Life Is a Cosmic Game You Play on Yourself
one_liner: Existence is a pretend game where the self forgets its own completeness, only to rediscover it.
key_points: You were always complete and all-knowing — the spiritual journey is a game of pretending you weren't
The soul seeks truth, meditates, and grows, only to realize it was never lost
Other people, conflict, and learning are all part of the self's self-devised illusion
The punchline: you could have 'stayed home' — the only response is laughter
